name: Wasp_Rule
brief: Wasp_Rule | Inputs: P1, C1, P2, C2 → R
context: Wasp plugin component: defines a single directional aggregation rule. Rules are DIRECTIONAL â€” HEXA|0→HEXA|1 does NOT imply HEXA|1→HEXA|0. Create two rules for bidirectional connections.
trigger_symptoms: aggregation only grows in one direction
solution_principle: Each rule is ONE direction: P1's connection C1 can attach to P2's connection C2. For bidirectional connectivity, create two rules with swapped indices. Part names (P1/P2) must exactly match Wasp_Basic Part NAME inputs. Connection indices (C1/C2) are 0-based integers matching the sequential order from Wasp_Connection From Direction. Multiple rules are merged via Merge before feeding into aggregation.
anti_patterns: Defining only one direction when bidirectional is needed â€” causes asymmetric growth
Part name string mismatch with Basic Part NAME input
preconditions: Wasp_Basic Part components defined with named parts
Connection indices known from Wasp_Connection From Direction
